name: Agent
description: A language model that writes a service declaration, and the fills that carry the service's own rules. It is a role of its own because STEGO's premise is that an agent's output must be constrained more tightly than a person's. STEGO's contract with an agent is the declaration and the generated slot interface; the fill itself is ordinary code, which STEGO does not generate.

name: Operator
description: Installs the compiler, deploys the generated service, supplies the trust roots and runs the cluster checks.

name: Platform engineer
description: Writes and versions the archetypes, components and mixins. Makes every accidental decision once, so no service author has to make it.

name: Service author
description: Writes the service declaration and the fills for one service, and qualifies each fill with tests.
